purpose: Improve the existing browser cockpit hands and surface rendering
status: Integrated visual improvement; provisional anatomy and animation

source.reference_basis: Official replica glove images and existing F1 production record; inferred anatomy, not measured driver dimensions

rejected_source_trial.reason: Flattened thumb/web and open-looking grip in the actual cockpit despite numerical clearance

derivative.processing: Manually placed 17-joint fitting rig with smooth explicit weights; provisional 300mm glove length and 0.6 source-depth factor; finger curl and thumb opposition baked; cuff bend; 65% decimation; fit against sampled runtime grip; normals recalculated; GLB exported and reimported

runtime.right_hand: Mirrored local Z, shared static geometry and atlas
runtime.steering: Both hands attached to the existing wheel frame, clamped to +/-180 degrees
runtime.sleeves: Tapered folded tube meshes with cubic curves following cuff position and wrist direction; fixed shoulders
runtime.loading_failure: Original capsule hands remain until textured asset loads; retained if loading fails
runtime.materials: Fabric bump, carbon weave, clearcoated cockpit paint, asphalt/gravel/guardrail bump, retuned daylight/exposure and reduced exterior car metallic response
runtime.build: ../../build.sh copies engine and embedded assets to docs and Design

qualification.asset_test: node test/driver-assets-test.js: PASS; source/export hashes, normals/UVs, shared static mesh, sampled vertex clearance, embedded data and built copies
qualification.browser_test: test/driver-pov-scene-check.js: PASS; actual asset loading, hidden fallback, geometry/maps, 12 steering samples including beyond-lock clamping, sleeve endpoint contact and wrist direction
qualification.performance: No controlled GPU or sustained frame-time benchmark; posed Chrome checks only

limits: This is a browser graphics improvement, not DLSS 5 or neural rendering
Rigid finger pose and mirrored markings remain; no independent right-hand texture or finger animation
No anatomically calibrated driver, elbow rig, cloth simulation or hand-over-hand steering; crossed arms at full lock remain approximate
Sampled vertex clearance is not a continuous triangle collision guarantee
Raised generated logos, inferred anatomy and occasional cuff/surface imperfections remain
Exterior car still uses the existing generic source, with baked highlights and approximate geometry
Existing track reconstruction and wet-road reflections remain approximate

dlss_reference.decision: Keep improving the current Three.js/WebGL build. No native engine port or NVIDIA DLSS integration performed.
